crossRefs.note: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’

translations.web: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’
translations.bsb: Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to try them out. Please excuse me.’
translations.kjv: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.
translations.asv: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them; I pray thee have me excused.
